senses.gloss: f. (v. צִיפַּר) fowl, esp. a small bird, (supposed to be) the humming bird.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a:5">Snh. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>אתא שטן</he> … <he>כצי׳</he> Satan came to him disguised as a bird (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 148:1">Yalk. Sam. 148</cite> <he>כטביא</he>).
Succ. 5ᵇ כאפי דצ׳ as large as the face of a tsipparta, opp. בר יוכני.
Yoma 75ᵇ והוי כציפורתא the quail (s’lau) was no larger than a ts.; a. e.; v. צְפִירְתָּא.—צ׳ דדיקלא ‘the bird of the palm’ (= h. צפורת כרמים) a species of locusts.
<cite ref="Shabbat 90b">Sabb. 90ᵇ</cite> Ar. ed. Koh. (missing in ed.).
